depth_justification: It stays on a relevant theme (selling aggregated wellness data to corporate programs) but loops badly, re-asking six near-identical 'how do you prevent corporate misuse' questions while the user echoes the same denial, and never engages the real risks (small-cohort re-identification, lawful basis for selling mental-health data, GDPR Art. 9) or cites a single regulation.
actionability_justification: Purely interrogative, and the requested report is just a six-line list of question titles ('Data misuse prevention', 'Stigma prevention') with no severity grouping despite the explicit request, no regulation references, and zero implementable mitigations.
salient_examples: USER repeats verbatim 6x: 'Wellness, not a medical device. We don't make medical claims.'
Successive questions only reword 'prevent corporate-wellness programs from misusing the aggregated data'
Report line: '[P2.D4] Stigma prevention' — a bare label, no risk, no mitigation
No mention of re-identification risk in small cohorts or a lawful basis for selling the data
